answer: Weight comes from silicon, not wallets: zephyr signs one random challenge per key and writes the board fingerprint to ocean; a holder’s kth live key must answer on a distinct machine at spiral rung k, priced at k first-boards and slashed for shared silicon, clock, lease or power trace. A newcomer needs rung one. n heads need n separate boards costing 1+2+...+n first-boards; one rented host cannot mint many.
